training_and_cv_labels.source_authority: PharmacotherapyDB v1.0 / Hetionet v1.0 (Himmelstein et al., 2017, CC0 1.0)
training_and_cv_labels.split_methodology: 5-fold outer / 3-fold inner nested cross-validation grouped by Compound-resembles-Compound (CrC) connected components to prevent structural analog leakage.

suite_a_prospective_temporal.source_authority: FDA Drug Approvals (2019-2023) & ClinicalTrials.gov Phase 3/Guideline Adjudications
suite_a_prospective_temporal.temporal_window: 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (0% direct CtD edges in Hetionet v1.0)
suite_a_prospective_temporal.description: Out-of-sample prospective repurposing pairs approved or validated in Phase 3 trials after the 2018-12-31 cutoff.

suite_b_rare_disease.source_authority: Orphanet / Hetionet v1.0 Low-Degree Disease Stratification (Node Degree <= 30)
suite_b_rare_disease.description: Evaluates micro-metapath sensitivity on sparse/rare disease nodes where dense hub pathways are absent.

suite_c_clinical_failures.source_authority: repoDB (Brown & Patel, Scientific Data 2017, DOI: 10.1038/sdata.2017.29) & ClinicalTrials.gov Terminated/Withdrawn Trials
suite_c_clinical_failures.description: Hard negative controls consisting of drug-disease pairs that entered clinical trials due to biological plausibility but failed efficacy or safety endpoints.

landmark_4_drug_classes.source_authority: FDA Landmark Repurposing Approvals (Spravato 2019, Lodoco 2023, Farxiga DAPA-HF 2020 & DAPA-CKD 2021, Invokana CREDENCE 2019, Wegovy/STEP-1 2021)
landmark_4_drug_classes.description: End-to-end stress test evaluating Cross-Graph Mechanism Jumping (Ketamine NMDA->BDNF, Colchicine Tubulin->NLRP3->IL1B, SGLT2i SLC5A2->Cardiorenal, GLP-1R Multi-Tissue Hypothalamic Axis).
